## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Privacy and source-of-truth impact

- Does this change affect credentials, provider data, persistence, telemetry, or local-first behavior?
- Does the original service remain the source of truth?

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented where needed.
- [ ] Tests or validation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private workspace content, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Relevant architecture and source boundaries remain intact.
